name: Agitators
summary: On Zephras Isle, unrest in Thendal Grove draws Yala Windwatcher's concern. The Al'Aketh cult has stirred peaceful wind sprites into hostile elementals, and its converts now threaten the grove.

sections.title: Disturbing the Grove
sections.body: Cultists of Al'Aketh have pushed into Thendal Grove and stirred the wind spirits who dwell there. Once peaceful, the sprites now rage as roiling winds, threatening anyone who passes through.

sections.title: A Painful Necessity
sections.body:
Yala Windwatcher asks you to subdue the enraged elementals and the Al'Aketh converts behind the unrest. Quieting the wind creatures may restore a fragile calm to the grove.

Yala grieves at the thought of shen'dorei blood shed among her own people. Yet while the cult remains, she sees little choice.

faq.answer: Yala Windwatcher asks you for help near Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What is the Al'Aketh cult doing in Thendal Grove?
faq.answer: The Al'Aketh cult has moved into Thendal Grove and stirred its native wind spirits into a violent frenzy.
Roiling Winds are native wind sprites of Zephras Isle, stirred by Al'Aketh cultists into aggressive elemental whirlwinds.

faq.q: Why is Yala Windwatcher saddened by killing the converts?
faq.answer: Yala grieves at shedding shen'dorei blood because the converts are her own people, led astray by dangerous cult teachings.

aliases: where do i go after agitators
faq.answer: After you finish Yala Windwatcher's work, you are directed to continue your duties with Return to Rorian.

faq.q: Where does this conflict take place?
faq.answer: The conflict centers on Thendal Grove, on Zephras Isle.

angles.text: As a shaman, you see cultists drive natural wind sprites into a violent frenzy. The upheaval in elemental balance calls for intervention.
As a druid, you see rogue cultists disturb Thendal Grove's natural harmony. The grove's native spirits urgently need defense.
